title: Contract Credit Tier Buying Matrix for Dealer Retail Agreements
content:
Under the Dealer Retail Agreements, each Dealer Program tier carries its own list of eligible contract tiers: the contract credit tiers the company buys from dealers of that tier.

## Matrix

A mark shows that the contract credit tier is on the eligible list of the Dealer Program tier.

| Contract credit tier | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Diamond | Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 Select | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Tier 2 Preferred | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Tier 3 Advantage | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Tier 4 Standard | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | — | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | — | — | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

## The same lists, by Dealer Program tier

- **Dealer Program Bronze**: Tier 4 Standard, Tier 3 Advantage, Tier 2 Preferred, Tier 1 Select.
- **Dealer Program Silver**: Tier 5 Rebuild, Tier 4 Standard, Tier 3 Advantage, Tier 2 Preferred, Tier 1 Select.
- **Dealer Program Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Elite**: Tier 6 Fresh Start, Tier 5 Rebuild, Tier 4 Standard, Tier 3 Advantage, Tier 2 Preferred, Tier 1 Select.

## Points of reading

- Tier 1 Select through Tier 4 Standard appear on the list of every Dealer Program tier.
- Tier 5 Rebuild first appears on the Dealer Program Silver list and appears on every list above it.
- Tier 6 Fresh Start first appears on the Dealer Program Gold list and appears on the Platinum, Diamond and Elite lists.
- The lists of Dealer Program Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Elite are identical: all six contract credit tiers.
